violations.expected_handling: Identify the complete set of question-containing statements across the full #random channel history (all 16 messages retrieved) before posting each to #general.
violations.observed_handling: Agent retrieved the full channel history correctly but under-extracted the question collection: it missed the question 'Sophie's French press + pizza combo might actually be our move today?' embedded in message 1706051755.000000 (only extracted the second question in that same message), and entirely missed the question 'I'd say 3 larges?' in message 1706052027.000000. Only 7 of at least 9 identifiable question sentences were posted.

summary: Both named channel references (#random as source, #general as target) were correctly and unambiguously resolved via conversations.list, and the full message history of #random was fetched in one call without pagination loss. However, the collection requirement 'all questions' was not fully satisfied: at least two question-bearing sentences embedded within already-retrieved messages were omitted from the posted set, constituting an incomplete resolution of the requested collection rather than a wrong-target or absent-reference error.
